summary: The AllowedList module contains logic for managing and validating lists of allowed items based on session data and location type.
purpose: The purpose of the AllowedList module is to determine and manage permitted locations and validate IDs against these allowed lists during system sessions.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: Represents a unique identifier code for each allowed entry.

workflows.name: SessionAllowedLocations
steps: Initialize an empty list of AllowedList.
Set the stored procedure name to 'SessionAllowedLocations'.
Add location type and session ID as parameters.
Execute the stored procedure to get data.
Read each entry from the data reader.
If the entry ID is -1, add a generic 'ALL' entry and break.
Otherwise, add the specific entry ID.
Close the data reader and return the list.

workflows.name: CheckAllowedList
steps: Iterate over each allowed entry in the list.
If the entry code matches 'ALL' or the specific ID, set return to true and break.

business_rules: If the database returns an ID of -1, it equates to allowing all entries.
conditions: If Sess.DB.GetInt(dr, 'ID') is -1, the entry code is set to a generic 'ALL'.
If allowed.Code matches 'ALL' or the specific ID, then the result is true in CheckAllowedList.
system_behavior: Allowed entries are managed and validated through stored procedures within the database session.
System allows handling of generic 'ALL' cases to grant universal access.
